description: Returns a composited send-or-wait recommendation for a Bitcoin transaction. Fetches live mempool and fee data, then outputs a machine-actionable verdict (SEND_NOW, WAIT, or URGENT_ONLY) with fee rates in sat/vB, mempool pressure level, and estimated savings if you wait. Ideal for agents that need a single decision call instead of parsing multiple raw mempool endpoints. Price: 15 sats per call.

l402_proof.description: L402 payment proof "<macaroon>:<preimage>". Omit on the first call; an unpaid call returns a 15 sat Lightning invoice and the macaroon. Pay the invoice, then repeat the call with this argument set.

urgency.description: How time-sensitive is your transaction? low=economy, medium=default, high=next-block.

name: btc_send_decision
